facts.text: I appreciate that Peter Quill's tough exterior hides a softer, more vulnerable side.
I find Peter Quill more relatable as a character because of his vulnerable side.
I like the dynamic between Peter Quill and the rest of the Guardians of the Galaxy.
I think the Guardians of the Galaxy are like a dysfunctional family that still has each other's backs.
I like how the Guardians of the Galaxy movies incorporate a lot of great music.
I think the soundtrack in the Guardians of the Galaxy movies is like its own character.
